Display Dantsu Flame (Casual Clothes)

Yeah, I knew it! Ehehe...
I guess I've watched it so many times that I've even memorized the scenery.

It was originally super popular in the Kansai region.
Apparently they even have new Tokyo-exclusive items, so I'm really looking forward to it!

(...It's true. Today... I've been dragging
Trainer all over the place, but—)
...Yes.

...And then, it just makes me want to face forward again.
Like once I've cried my eyes out and emptied my head, I can make a fresh start.
(...I see. Maybe that girl... felt the exact same way I do right now—?)

(So much... of the deeply important parts of me.
All the things I love, the things I hold dear... You've gotten to know them all—)
.........U-Um! The thing is—

I still have time, so... maybe I'll stop by.
Trainer, this is where I—
...Ah! Which means it's also close to where they filmed that scene!

Huh, Trainer...? Ah, it is you!
Fufu, what a coincidence. Are you heading somewhere today?
Ah, but... that pillar! It was featured in that passionate scene—!

I mean—ah, um... It's a movie about a cheerleading club.
There's a scene where they practice all summer under that pillar.

Well, have a good time shopping!
Sorry for holding you up!
...*sniff*. Haah, I can't take it~... No matter how many times I watch this ending—

Um... I was actually thinking of heading over to that
new specialty cheesecake shop that just opened.

...Well then... um.
S-Shall we go... together, then?!

So, if you'd like... I'd love it if you could join me.
And share the things I love.

Yes! It's the place where an iconic scene took place—
one you simply can't leave out when discussing the movie! And it seems to be near here!
"Huh? Don't worry about it! Making it up to me... you really don't have to fret over that!"
One day off, while out shopping—
Wait, huh? ...Come to think of it, isn't this—

Next time... would you let me come along
for the things you enjoy too, Trainer?!

Everyone else seems to shine so much brighter than me.
Still, I don't want to lose! That's when she shouts with all that overflowing emotion—

Fufu, it was brought to our table just a moment ago...
and we already cleaned our plates in no time, didn't we?

It's an older movie, so streaming services rarely carry it.
You have to borrow it from a rental shop.

Fufu, somehow... it was such a wondrous day.
Eating cake, visiting a filming location, and even watching that movie...

Of course it was delicious!
Ugh~ it was so meltingly good, I felt so happy!

Anything is fine! Movies, music, books,
um, even video games, absolutely anything...!!

Ah, no! It's just...
I thought the setting of my favorite movie might be around here—

Ehh?! B-But... but, between the cheesecake and this,
aren't you just tagging along with whatever I want to do?!

Trainer...!!
Right?! It is, isn't it?! Ugh, it makes me cry every single time—

Huh?! Ah, no! That's not it, I don't mean it as paying you back!
It's just, I want to know more about you too, Trainer—

I smile at the bewildered girl and continue.
Her favorite food, places holding deep memories, the movie that supports her spirit—

It's genuinely amazing~! The one I'm especially curious about is...
Wait, ah! I'm sorry, I'm just rambling on and on...!
Huh?! A-Are... you sure...?
.........I do yearn for it, yes.

...Yes! I'm sorry, Trainer, I've got to run!
Let me... properly tell you about that another time.

No, um... L-Looking back on it like this, I feel so guilty
for dragging you along with all my personal whims...!

Keep it a secret, but... to be honest, whenever I'm alone in the dorm,
I actually practice imitating her in front of the mirror...

Yeah! Today was my first time having it, but I fell totally in love with it...
I was thinking of going again next weekend, too.
...A-Are you... really okay with that?

Thank you for the meal. As for Trainer... Ah, you finished every bite!
Did you like it?

I ended up having you tag along out of nowhere, after all.
...I'm so, so glad you enjoyed it~.
...! Trainer...

The protagonist faces that pillar and shouts out her feelings toward the other girls!
Vowing that she'll definitely reclaim the center spot!

Ah, but you had some shopping to do, right? Let's head back soon!
To be heading home feeling this happy... ehehe, it's such bliss.

Like re-enacting the scene where she throws her phone while shouting out her feelings.
Ah, of course, I only threw my phone onto the bed, though...

There's! ...There's nothing here!!
...Well, I guess that makes sense... As a location, it's literally just under an overpass.

Huh, Dantsu's recommended cheesecake shop?!
Wait, I wanna go, I wanna go~!! Are you inviting me?!

" ...Hey! Tell me what you recommend next time!
To pay you back, I'll tag along for anything!"
I was... really oblivious, wasn't I?

——...Now I really want to watch that movie again.
Maybe I'll go rent it later.

Like shouting that line in a whisper—
"I'm definitely going to be the lead role!"——

And so... Dantsu Flame and I watched the movie together in the Trainer's Office.
The cheerleading girl's burning passion struck a deep chord—

Taking the opportunity to try the new item, a fluffy sweetness fills my mouth.
Its unprecedented tenderness made it impossible to put my fork down.

Haah, pure satisfaction...♪ Today was my special treat day,
so starting with training next week, I'll work even harder than usual!
